objective: Introduce broad and mid-scale terrain zoning that leads the wide shot to the shrine while confining fine ground grain to the near field.
prohibitedChanges: Do not edit Level.js, foliage, lighting, post-processing, or camera poses.
Do not retune the separate parallax ridge band for pixels already proved to be macro heightfield.
invariants: No new geometry or draw calls
assumptions: One low-frequency world-space mask plus a bounded route-scale term can create visual hierarchy without changing terrain geometry.
unresolvedQuestions: Which existing shader terms cause the near-to-shrine fine ripple cadence, and can they be range-gated without erasing material identity?
testsRequired: Coordinator-owned coherent phone/MEDIUM recapture and hostile review
risks: Terrain changes affect every review frame
Broad zones can become obvious procedural blobs
Suppressing fine grain may worsen the existing far-range detail criterion
